description: Update the test suite to explicitly skip specific logging-related tests that fail under Python 3.13 and newer. This is a temporary measure to maintain test suite stability while broader changes to the logging system are developed separately. The feature should not modify the actual logging functionality, only the test execution behavior.
functional_requirements: Identify and update the helper function responsible for conditionally skipping tests to correctly target Python 3.13+
Apply explicit skip decorators or markers to the specific failing tests in the exception handler and logging middleware test modules
Ensure the skip reason clearly indicates the tests are temporarily disabled due to Python 3.13 compatibility issues pending future refactoring
